candidate_status: Strongest inspected learned public-role candidate, not independently accepted; F55 uses 12 signed int8 supervised operator parameters and a 23-byte model-plus-state payload. No proof of equal whole-native memory against 576B, and full public algebraic solver may dominate.
hypothesis: Learn a shared compositional role representation that can apply unseen role compositions with an operator algebra not encountered during fitting; use contextual public evidence to infer task-specific operators and a bounded recurrent state rather than fixed per-family algebraic role tables.
novel_mechanism: Factor each public role example into learned transition-invariant basis and signed/inverse composition; train across mixed observed abelian and noncommuting training algebras, then evaluate a held-out, previously unobserved group composition rule and lengths greater than training. No hidden operator identity, role family label, or answer at evaluation.

cohort.trained_operator_classes: two source-independent public composition algebras fixed before source code
cohort.sealed_operator_class: third algebra with noncommuting role products and reversed/inverted unseen chains; not a mere mod7 seed change

controls: unchanged F55 learned 12-int8 posterior / variable-binding candidate
unchanged F52 quantized recurrent relational state
fully public exact algebraic symbolic solver

budgets.public_examples_and_noise: identical per task across arms, values frozen before generation
budgets.total_native_residency: must measure; cannot claim native 576B from Python model
budgets.compute: candidate total FIT training+inference amortized over exactly 128 sealed unseen tasks <= cheapest correct frozen public symbolic control using deterministic operation count AND measured matched-runner CPU
budgets.memory: max full-task measured resident+temporary bytes <= strongest eligible public control; model weights, indexing and recurrent buffers included

admission.primary: on 128 completely unseen operator-class/composition tasks, strictly better exact answers and successful 10/12-hop composition than strongest public cost-matched control; >=5 percentage point gain precommitted
admission.resource: compute and full memory <= chosen strongest control; fail if cost exceeds, even if accuracy improves
admission.secondary: each held operator class and length must be nonregressing; independent source+model replication using two sealed source-birth environments
admission.provenance: full source/prereg Git blobs pinned BEFORE implementation and first use; per-example positive/negative, no retroactive tuning
admission.no_leakage: never use protected originals, previous F55 FIT/diagnostic, source-generation labels or held family identifiers to choose representations
